selection.scope: All sūtras of the Vidyut Aṣṭādhyāyī sūtrapāṭha (adhyāyas 1-8).
selection.crosscheck_note: Vidyut is the sole build source. A separate comparison against the read-only iks-core Pāṇini fixture is documented in README and is not a build dependency.
